evidence.quote: The horizontal motion is uniform because there is no external force in the horizontal direction.

concepts.name: Uniform horizontal motion in ballistic flight

evidence.quote: In the vertical plane, weight is the only external force acting on the object.
The maximum altitude changes as the square of the launch velocity.

objectives: Describe horizontal position as uniform motion with constant velocity over time
Calculate vertical velocity and vertical position over time under constant gravity
Calculate maximum altitude as the square of initial vertical velocity divided by twice gravitational acceleration
